title: Gaussian free field limits throughout the balanced six-vertex regime

result.label: Gaussian free field limits throughout the balanced six-vertex regime
result.statement: The balanced square-lattice six-vertex height field with a=b=1 and 0 c 2 converges to a Gaussian free field, including at the endpoint c = 2. The plane state is defined by balanced-torus limits. For unit height increments and Green kernel -(2 )^ -1 |x-y|, the exact variance multiplier is 1/ (c/2).
